new: The UTC time (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ) when the shape of this schema last changed.

old: The data exported to MSPDI, and the data that only GRS uses.
new: The data that GRS exports to MSPDI, and the data that only GRS uses.

new: Same as MSPDI Project.

old: Same as MSPDI Calendars.
new: Same as MSPDI Calendars.

old: Same as MSPDI Resources.
new: Same as MSPDI Resources.

old: Same as MSPDI Assignments.
new: Same as MSPDI Assignments.

new: The task groups; GRS shows each one as one row in both the Task Group Panel and the Task Group Area. taskGroupMembers says which tasks each task group holds. On reading an MSPDI file, GRS makes the task groups from the WBS.

old: Which task group each task belongs to: one entry per task, from taskUid to taskGroupId.
new: Which task group each task belongs to: one entry per task, from taskUid to taskGroupId.

old: How each task is drawn (shape, colors and outline width): exactly one entry per task.
new: How GRS draws each task (shape, colors and outline width): exactly one entry per task.

new: One record per task that came from an imported MSPDI file: which file and which task in that file, so that a later import of the same file updates that task instead of adding a copy. A task made in GRS has no record.

old: The plan as it was before: a saved copy of earlier task dates, matched to the current tasks by uid and drawn as an outline over them for comparison.
new: The earlier plan: a saved copy of earlier task dates. GRS matches the copy to the current tasks by uid and draws the copy as an outline over the current tasks for comparison.

old: Comment boxes on the chart. Each one points at a task, a highlight box or a free point.
new: Comment boxes in the Task Group Area. Each comment box points at a task, a highlight box or a free point.

old: Highlight boxes: rectangles on the chart that mark a range of days over a range of task groups, drawn with a frame, a fill or both.
new: Highlight boxes: rectangles in the Task Group Area that mark a range of days over a range of task groups. GRS draws each highlight box with a frame, a fill or both.

old: How the document is drawn when it is opened. Keys that always have a value are always written.
new: How GRS draws the document when the document opens. GRS always writes the keys that always have a value.

old: Display scale of the schedule drawing, in percent: at 100 every ...Px value is drawn as that many CSS pixels, at 50 at half size. It scales shapes and text together; it does not change the app header, the command palette or the browser zoom.
new: Display scale of the drawing in the Schedule Canvas, in percent: at 100 GRS draws every ...Px value as that many CSS pixels, at 50 at half size. This value scales shapes and text together and does not change the App Header, the Command Palette or the browser zoom.

new: Text size step of the schedule: small, medium or large, which are 7.5, 8.75 and 10 CSS pixels at displayScalePercent 100. The document opens at this step; a reader who changes the step edits the document.

new: How deep task groups with treeState auto open. A top-level task group is depth 1. With value N, task groups down to depth N are open, so GRS shows rows down to depth N + 1; 0 shows only the top-level task groups, closed.

new: Where the view starts when the document opens: notDecided lets GRS choose, placed gives the day at the left edge and the task group at the top edge.

old: notDecided: no person has chosen a place yet, and GRS chooses one when it opens the document; placed: the other keys give the place.
new: notDecided: no person has chosen a place yet, and GRS chooses one when GRS opens the document; placed: the other keys give the place.

old: The day at the left edge of the view.
new: The day at the left edge of the view.

old: Where the left edge falls inside leftEdgeDay, as a part of that day; 0 is the start of the day.
new: Where the left edge falls inside leftEdgeDay, as a part of that day; 0 is the start of the day.

new: Where the top edge falls inside that task group, as a part of the step of the task group (the row height in the Task Group Area plus the gap below), not in pixels; 0 is the top of the row.
note: its band height -> "the row height in the Task Group Area" (the row of the task group)

old: The span of days, firstDay to lastDay (both included), that Fit to screen and picture export show instead of the whole schedule when isFixed is true. Absent means no fit span.
new: The span of days, firstDay to lastDay (both included), that fitting the schedule to the window and PNG and SVG export show instead of the whole schedule when isFixed is true. Absent means no fit span.

new: The first day of the fit span (included), in the time zone that GRS shows the Schedule Canvas in (viewTimeZone).

old: The last day of the fit span; its column is included.
new: The last day of the fit span; the fit span includes the column of that day.

old: When true, Fit to screen and picture export show the fit span instead of the whole schedule. Opening the document does not move the view.
new: When true, fitting the schedule to the window and PNG and SVG export show the fit span instead of the whole schedule. Opening the document does not move the view.

old: The time zone that the time ruler and the shown date-times use: sameAsScheduleData follows project.scheduleDataTimeZone, fixed uses the offset given here.
new: The time zone that the Time Ruler and the shown date-times use: sameAsScheduleData follows project.scheduleDataTimeZone, fixed uses the offset given here.

old: sameAsScheduleData: show the schedule data time zone, and follow it when it changes; fixed: show the offset given here.
new: sameAsScheduleData: show the schedule data time zone, and follow the schedule data time zone when that time zone changes; fixed: show the offset given here.

old: The UTC offset that the chart is shown in.
new: The UTC offset that GRS shows the Schedule Canvas in.

new: Up to four extra clocks. While GRS shows the time of day, GRS shows each extra clock as one more row under the Time Ruler.

old: The UTC offset of this extra clock.
new: The UTC offset of this extra clock.

new: Whether this clock is the standard-time or the daylight-time zone of the offset of this clock. This value picks the zone name that GRS shows; GRS uses the offset itself all year.

old: Whether the time of day is shown on the chart; the stored date-times keep their time either way. A new document starts with false.
new: Whether GRS shows the time of day on the Schedule Canvas; the stored date-times keep their time either way. A new document starts with false.

old: Whether plan bars are shown, apart from isActualVisible. A new document starts with true.
new: Whether GRS shows Plan Bars, apart from isActualVisible. A new document starts with true.

new: Whether GRS shows the planned dates to the right of each Name Label. A new document starts with false.

old: Whether actual bars are shown, apart from isPlanVisible. A new document starts with true.
new: Whether GRS shows Actual Bars, apart from isPlanVisible. A new document starts with true.

old: Whether the percent complete label of each task is shown. A new document starts with false.
new: Whether GRS shows the Percent Complete Label of each task. A new document starts with false.

old: Whether the earlier plan (baselineTasks) is drawn over the current tasks. A new document starts with false.
new: Whether GRS draws the earlier plan (baselineTasks) over the current tasks. A new document starts with false.

new: Whether GRS draws the Progress Line: the line from the status date through the progress point of each task. A new document starts with false.

new: Whether GRS draws Progress Markers and Resume Icons; while GRS shows Delay Diagnostics, GRS draws the Progress Markers even when this value is false. A new document starts with true.

old: Whether dependency lines are drawn. A new document starts with true.
new: Whether GRS draws Dependency Lines. A new document starts with true.

old: Whether the assignee label of each task is shown. A new document starts with false.
new: Whether GRS shows the Assignee Label of each task. A new document starts with false.

old: Whether vertical date grid lines are drawn. A new document starts with false.
new: Whether GRS draws vertical Date Grid Lines. A new document starts with false.

new: Whether GRS draws the Group Grid Lines between task groups, in the Task Group Area and in the Task Group Panel. A new document starts with true.

new: up stacks the tasks of a task group so that the tasks climb to a goal at the upper right; down stacks them so that the tasks descend to a goal at the lower right. A new document starts with up.

old: Whether the theme is monochrome. A new document starts with false.
new: Whether the theme is monochrome. A new document starts with false.

new: Width of the Task Group Panel, in CSS pixels at displayScalePercent 100.

old: The state of the head of the task group panel (level 0), above all top-level task groups. collapsed draws no task group at all. A new document starts with auto.
new: The state of the head of the Task Group Panel (level 0), above all top-level task groups. collapsed draws no task group at all. A new document starts with auto.

new: How GRS shows the three tables: the Search Panel, the Delay Diagnostics Report and the Resource List.

new: How GRS shows the tables of the Search Panel: schedule filter, checked rows, column filters and sort.

old: Whether the schedule filter of this table is on; while it is on, the chart draws only what the checked rows of this table select. A new document starts with false.
new: Whether the schedule filter of this table is on; while the schedule filter is on, GRS draws in the Task Group Area only what the checked rows of this table select. A new document starts with false.

old: The column filters of the Search Panel tables (the task table and the comment box table), one per filtered column, by the column names of those tables. Absent means no column is filtered.
new: The column filters of the Search Panel tables (the task table and the comment box table), one per filtered column, by the column names of those tables. Absent means no column has a filter.

old: How this table is sorted. Absent means the default order.
new: How GRS sorts this table. Absent means the default order.

old: How the Delay Diagnostics Report table is shown: schedule filter, checked rows, column filters and sort.
new: How GRS shows the Delay Diagnostics Report table: schedule filter, checked rows, column filters and sort.

old: Whether the schedule filter of this table is on; while it is on, the chart draws only what the checked rows of this table select. A new document starts with false.
new: Whether the schedule filter of this table is on; while the schedule filter is on, GRS draws in the Task Group Area only what the checked rows of this table select. A new document starts with false.

old: Whether the schedule filter of this table is on; while it is on, the chart draws only what the checked rows of this table select. A new document starts with false.
new: Whether the schedule filter of this table is on; while the schedule filter is on, GRS draws in the Task Group Area only what the checked rows of this table select. A new document starts with false.

note: actor "GRS" for saving taken from fileSavedAt (D260)

old: When the schedule data last changed. watchChanges looks only at this time.
new: When the schedule data last changed. watchChanges looks only at this time.

old: When the document last changed, in the schedule data or in documentSettings.
new: When the document last changed, in the schedule data or in documentSettings.

old: When the document was last written to its file, in UTC. Absent until it has been written once.
new: When GRS last wrote the document to the file, in UTC. Absent until the first write.

old: Who wrote the document last: {"kind":"user"} for a person on the screen, {"kind":"template"} for the shipped start-up template, {"kind":"agent","name":...} for an Agent API caller.
new: Who wrote the document last: {"kind":"user"} for a person in GRS, {"kind":"template"} for the shipped start-up template, {"kind":"agent","name":...} for an Agent API caller.
note: on the screen -> "in GRS"

old: Who wrote: a person on the screen, the shipped start-up template, or an Agent API caller.
new: Who wrote: a person in GRS, the shipped start-up template, or an Agent API caller.
note: on the screen -> "in GRS"

old: user: a person on the screen; template: the shipped start-up template; agent: an Agent API caller.
new: user: a person in GRS; template: the shipped start-up template; agent: an Agent API caller.
note: on the screen -> "in GRS"

old: The name that the Agent API caller gave for itself.
new: The name that the Agent API caller gave for itself.

old: One note about a change made to the document: when, who, which part, what, why, and anything else. Only changedAt is required.
new: One note about a change made to the document: when, who, which part, what, why, and anything else. Every entry has changedAt; the other properties are optional.
note: is required kept as the schema term (adjective)

old: When the change was made, in UTC. GRS fills in the time the entry is added; a person may change it.
new: When the change happened, in UTC. GRS fills in the time of adding the entry; a person may change the time.

old: Who made the change: the name a person typed, or the name an AI gave for itself.
new: Who made the change: the name a person typed, or the name an AI gave for itself.

old: Which part of the document the change affected.
new: Which part of the document the change affected.

old: What was changed.
new: What changed.

old: Why the change was made.
new: The reason for the change.

old: Anything else about the change.
new: Anything else about the change.

old: Carried MSPDI values, keyed by their MSPDI names.
new: Carried MSPDI values, keyed by their MSPDI names.

old: One carried MSPDI element, kept whole and written back in its place.
new: One carried MSPDI element, which GRS keeps whole and writes back in place.

old: The order of this element within its owner, used to write it back in its place.
new: The order of this element within the owner, which GRS uses to write the element back in place.

old: The element name in the MSPDI file, spelled exactly as it came.
new: The element name, spelled exactly as in the MSPDI file.

old: The leaf values of the element, by their names.
new: The leaf values of the element, by their names.

old: The child elements nested in this element.
new: The child elements nested in this element.

old: A date without a time of day, written YYYY-MM-DD. A range of days (firstDay and lastDay) includes both days. Each property that uses it says which time zone the day is in.
new: A date without a time of day, written YYYY-MM-DD. A range of days (firstDay and lastDay) includes both days. Each property that uses Day says which time zone the day is in.

old: A wall-clock date-time in project.scheduleDataTimeZone, written YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS with no offset, as MSPDI writes it. GRS reads it to the minute: it ignores the seconds.
new: A wall-clock date-time in project.scheduleDataTimeZone, written YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS with no offset, as MSPDI writes a date-time. GRS reads the value to the minute and ignores the seconds.

old: A time of day, as MSPDI writes it.
new: A time of day, as MSPDI writes a time.

old: A point in time in UTC, written YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.
new: A point in time in UTC, written YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

old: A fixed offset from UTC, written like UTC+09:00. Daylight saving time is never applied.
new: A fixed offset from UTC, written like UTC+09:00. GRS never applies daylight saving time.

old: A color: theme uses the color that the theme gives this place, palette names a palette color, custom gives its own values for the light and the dark theme. Where a color may be omitted, an absent color means that fill or line is not drawn.
new: A color: theme uses the color that the theme gives this place, palette names a palette color, custom gives the color's own values for the light and the dark theme. Where a color may be absent, an absent color means GRS does not draw that fill or line.

old: theme: the color that the theme gives this place; palette: a named palette color; custom: its own values for the light and the dark theme.
new: theme: the color that the theme gives this place; palette: a named palette color; custom: the color's own values for the light and the dark theme.

old: The palette color, by its stored name.
new: The palette color, by the stored name.

old: The color for the light theme; at least one of light and dark is present.
new: The color for the light theme; at least one of light and dark is present.

old: The color for the dark theme; at least one of light and dark is present.
new: The color for the dark theme; at least one of light and dark is present.

old: One side of a custom color: its value, and whether a person chose it or GRS derived it. One side may be omitted; GRS derives it from the other side when it opens the file.
new: One side of a custom color: the value, and whether a person chose the value or GRS derived the value. One side may be absent; GRS derives the missing side from the other side when opening the file.

old: The color value for this theme.
new: The color value for this theme.

old: chosen: a person chose this value; derived: GRS made it from the other side when it loaded the document.
new: chosen: a person chose this value; derived: GRS made the value from the other side when loading the document.

old: The color of a task group band: the same as Color, except that the palette color ink is not offered.
new: The color of the row of a task group in the Task Group Area: the same as Color, except that BandColor offers no palette color ink.
note: longer than before (band rule)

old: A filter on one column of a table: values hides rows by their shown value, dateRange hides rows whose date is outside a range of days.
new: A filter on one column of a table: values hides rows by their shown value, dateRange hides rows whose date is outside a range of days.

old: values: hide rows by their shown value; dateRange: hide rows whose date is outside firstDay..lastDay.
new: values: hide rows by their shown value; dateRange: hide rows whose date is outside firstDay..lastDay.

old: The column that the filter is on, by its stable column name.
new: The column that the filter is on, by the stable column name.

old: The values whose rows are hidden; a status or a type is given by its stable name, any other value by its shown text.
new: The values whose rows the filter hides; write a status or a type by the stable name, any other value by the shown text.

old: Whether the rows with an empty cell in this column are hidden.
new: Whether the filter hides the rows with an empty cell in this column.

old: The first day that is kept (included), as a day in the schedule data time zone (project.scheduleDataTimeZone).
new: The first day that the filter keeps (included), as a day in the schedule data time zone (project.scheduleDataTimeZone).

old: The last day that is kept (included).
new: The last day that the filter keeps (included).

old: How a table is sorted: by one column, in one direction.
new: How GRS sorts a table: by one column, in one direction.

old: The column that the table is sorted by, by its stable column name.
new: The column that GRS sorts the table by, by the stable column name.

old: The direction of the sort.
new: The direction of the sort.

old: The stable English name of a table column; each table takes only the names of its own columns.
new: The stable English name of a table column; each table takes only the names of the columns in that table.
